verdict.rationale: Supabase is a managed backend/Postgres platform, so automatic compute autoscaling is a fair question. However, the evidence pack never documents compute that scales up and down automatically without manual resizes or downtime. Read Replicas (load balancing) and globally distributed Edge Functions are adjacent features, not documented autoscaling of compute.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, compute autoscales up and down with load automatically, without manual resizes or downtime
